snippet.title: Don't Drain The Lake — Trailer: The Valley Keeps Things
snippet.description:
Grandpa left you his cabin and one rule: whatever happens, don't drain the lake.

Don't Drain The Lake is a first-person incremental about emptying a mountain reservoir — by bucket, pump and siphon — against your late grandfather's one request. Every metre you drain moves the sun, breaks the lake into pools and gives something back. Skip stones off the pier (Grandpa's record: 11), hop the old ferry pilings to his rod, find the places the valley has kept... and find out what he was hiding at the bottom.

The game is not on Steam yet — the store page is on its way (PC & Mac).
Play the free demo (Windows & Mac): https://logikcb4.itch.io/dont-drain-the-lake

Want to talk about the game, share ideas or follow development? Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/py5R6NeGyp
